Package aor.proj3t.service.interfaces

Interface WorkplaceService

All Known Implementing Classes:
WorkplaceServiceImpl
public interface WorkplaceService
Service interface for workplace management operations. This interface defines the contract for workplace data management and operations within the organizational structure of the application.

Key workplace services include:

  • Workplace Retrieval: Fetching all available workplace locations
  • Data Conversion: Converting workplace entities to DTOs for client consumption
  • Organizational Structure: Supporting user-workplace associations

This service provides the foundation for workplace management and serves as a basis for organizational structure within the user management system. Future enhancements may include workplace creation, updates, and detailed management.
